snippet.title: Happy nuclear demo gameplay | Where's yourself at? 🕵️
snippet.description:
ABOUT THE GAME:
Happy Nuclear (by Hi-Develop) is an evidence-based investigation game where players act as detectives to prevent a disaster. They analyze interconnected case information on an investigation board, primarily using old CCTV and access logs. Cases link together at the end, and each replay introduces changes.

Find Happy nuclear here 👇
Steam 🔵 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678870/Happy_Nuclear/
